notes.title: DEMO v0.1.20 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, we're the development team of [b][i]Halcyon Days at Taoyuan[/i][/b].[/p][p]First and foremost, we’d like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support and feedback, which has been a tremendous encouragement to us![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Based on your suggestions, we’ve optimized several features in the DEMO to enhance your gaming experience.
Here’s a full list of this update’s contents:[/p][list][*][p]Added a rumor system: Visit Wanhuan to hear villagers’ gossip and choose whether to lend a hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the task tracking panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to delete tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the logic for updating pinned tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the water-adding mechanic for the livestock shed—it now consumes water from buckets according to actual needs.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated in-game documentation regarding the R key functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where item details in chests were displayed incompletely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where trees at the bottom of the farm obstructed the construction area.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to join our QQ group (205068596) or reach out through other channels.
We promise to take every piece of feedback seriously![/p]

notes.title: DEMO v0.1.19 Update
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone from the [i]Halcyon Days at Taoyuan[/i] dev team![/b][/p][p]Once again, huge thanks for playing our demo and sharing your feedback—your enthusiasm fuels our progress![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Based on your suggestions, we've rolled out these improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Social Panel Revamp：[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added NPC profiles with exact favorability metrics, gift preferences, and basic info[/p][/*][*][p]Reserved space for future "Story Recap" feature[/p][/*][*][p][b]Display Optimizations：[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added borderless window mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed intermittent resolution-switching failures[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unstable resolutions (known to cause screen flickering)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Expanded wooden deck area at Xiao Family Fishing Boat dock[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upgraded tools now arrive via carrier pigeon delivery (no pickup needed!) [/p][/*][*][p]Added Contribution Value display to obtained items[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upgraded ore visuals with improved collision physics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ESC key conflict (no longer opens Settings when closing panels)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Have thoughts? Join our QQ Group ([b]205068596[/b]) or reach out—we read every submission![/p]

notes.title: v0.1.18 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, we are the development team of [b][i]Halcyon Days at Taoyuan[/i][/b].[/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, thank you all for playing and sharing your feedback—it has been incredibly helpful![/p][p][/p][p]Based on your suggestions, we’ve made several minor optimizations to enhance your gaming experience.
Below are all the updates in this patch:
➢ Added a single-use item, [b]\[Huicheng][/b], allowing quick teleportation from inside the cave to its entrance.
➢ Reduced the number of chambers leading to the cave’s boss room.
➢ Added a feed station in Le Hongdi’s courtyard—players can now borrow feed for free.
➢ Fixed a bug where story dialogues could get stuck.
➢ Optimized the issue where wall decorations couldn’t be picked up after removal; they are now automatically added to your backpack.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to join our QQ group (205068596) or reach out through other channels.
We will carefully consider every piece of feedback you share![/p]

notes.title: v0.1.16 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, we're the development team of [b][i]Halcyon Days at Taoyuan[/i][/b]![/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, we'd like to express our sincere gratitude for your continued support and feedback—it has been incredibly motivating![/p][p][/p][p]Based on your suggestions, we've optimized the map features and the time UI to enhance your gaming experience.[/p][p]Here's a full list of this update's contents:[/p][olist][*][p]Added real-time NPC location tracking on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Added villager trade availability indicators on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the time UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced stamina cost for watering from 2 points to 1 point.[/p][/*][*][p]Scythe no longer consumes stamina when swung without hitting targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Watering can no longer drains stamina or water during repeated use.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed accidental call UI activation via Spacebar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unrefreshed tool animations after switching inventory tabs with \[R].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed calendar display issues when reloading saved games.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched exploit allowing duplicate item collection from the stone mill.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted scheduling conflicts for the Zhang brothers.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved guidance in certain Encyclopedia sections.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized localized text in specific interface elements.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]If you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to join our QQ Group (205068596) or reach out through other channels.[/p][p]We'll carefully consider every piece of input![/p]

notes.title: Halcyon Days at Taoyuan Joins June Steam Next Fest! Free Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that [i]Halcyon Days at Taoyuan[/i] will debut at the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] from [b]June 10 to 19, 2024 (PT)[/b]![/p][p]
Experience these features in our substantial preview:
• 🗺️ [b]Full Exploration[/b]: All scenic maps & NPC interactions
• 🎯 [b]Complete Gameplay Systems[/b]: Core mechanics + every mini-game
• ⚔️ [b]Strategic Adventures[/b]: Partial main/side quests + most combat mazes & tameable beasts
• 🛋️ [b]Creative Freedom[/b]: All furniture/decor + complete recipe/cooking collections[/p]
